decisions.reason: “Cry of awe” plus “When” keeps the moment without BASE’s comma-heavy “cry, filled with awe.”
SOL drops 모든 광경, weakens 안간힘을 to mere struggle, and replaces 숨기기 with “contain.”
BASE invents “as yesterday”; SOL renders 또렷이 as clarity without that comparison.
SOL drops 활짝 from 날개를 활짝 펴고.
Split copulas match the 이요/이다 parallel better than a single “and.”
SOL drops 얼굴이 보인다 (Jeok’s visual POV) and replaces 상반신 with unsupported “halfway.”
SOL loses 도가니 and 한 번에 뒤집어지며; BASE’s “let out” is weaker than 터트렸다.
decisions.replacement: The solemn courtyard was overturned in an instant, transforming into a cauldron of madness. Jeok Cheongang finally burst into the laughter he had been holding back.

decisions.reason: SOL’s “arose” flattens 태동하던 (nascent emergence) into a completed rise.
Preserves the 광란의 도가니 callback and 가라앉다 as “settled.”
좁쌀만 한 modifies the room; BASE wrongly turns the people into millet grains.
SOL drops 뼛속까지 and weakens the 성골 oxymoron (“blue-blooded beggar to the bone”).
“Bursting at the seams” is the English for 미어터질; “wait outside” matches 나가 있겠습니다.
SOL drops 아까부터; BASE’s “haven’t you smelled… since earlier” is stiff.
decisions.replacement: “That guy’s finally leaving. Squad Leader, haven’t you been smelling a mutt’s ass around here since earlier?”

decisions.reason: SOL drops the smell verb 나다; BASE is already natural dialogue.
Same order, more spoken English: “get out, both of you.”
SOL drops 벌컥 and turns 고개 숙이다 into a bow.
인사 here is a farewell as they leave; BASE’s “hello” is the wrong greeting.
SOL drops glossary 스킬/Skill and assigns the growth to Mimi without support.
Same sequence, cleaner syntax than “left following.”
“Wild” fits 천둥벌거숭이; “commotion” is closer to 난리 than “scene.”
SOL weakens 가라앉은, loses 평소의, and “smiling” undershoots 웃음 before “You’re laughing?”
SOL drops the explicit 웃지 that sets up 웁니까.
Both miss 슬그머니; SOL also loses 와르르.
decisions.replacement: The stern expression he had been struggling to maintain collapsed all at once. Jeok Cheongang sneakily turned his head toward the window.

decisions.reason: BASE adds unsupported “from how far they had risen”; SOL turns 피 나시는 줄 into future “going to start bleeding.”
decisions.replacement: “About fifty people besides me probably saw it too. I thought the corners of your mouth were bleeding.”

decisions.reason: 차이나 조커 is the China Joker meme; SOL’s “Chinese Joker” renames the joke.
SOL genericizes 확인 사살 and changes 툭 내뱉었다 to muttering.
BASE completes 했다 into “You did well,” spoiling the incomplete-utterance joke.
SOL drops the flustered 아 that expands 했다.
SOL’s “blazing” intensifies 벌겋게 달아오른.
SOL naturalizes 입가 but replaces 그 한마디면 충분하다 with “all I needed to hear.”
decisions.replacement: My smile deepened. Yes, those few words were enough.

decisions.reason: “Something about his expression” captures 어째 better than “rather strange.”
SOL’s “almost” contradicts 마저 (even).
SOL replaces 분위기 훈훈하고 with a “heartwarming moment.”
Punchier shouted cadence without meaning change.
그때였다 is a dramatic “it was then”; SOL flattens it to a when-clause.
Same meaning; “sharper” plus the contraction better match Taekyung’s narration.
“Out of nowhere” over-specifies 갑자기.
SOL singularizes 많은 위기 and drops 이제는.
SOL loses 한 줄기 and weakens 열풍 to a generic gust of hot wind.
Gruffer spoken cadence; “up here” matches the stair approach.
SOL replaces 목소리 with “complaint.”
BASE’s “a benefactor” is unclear; SOL inserts the name “Jeok,” absent from the Korean.
decisions.replacement: “Impatient, you say? Hearing that from you, Benefactor, gives me a rather strange feeling.”

decisions.reason: SOL adds an explicit apology the Korean does not state.
SOL replaces 가득한/쪼글쪼글한 with unsupported “deep wrinkles.”
Same 포권 in more natural English.
Splits the overloaded relative clause without losing the visit or the Divine Physician.
SOL’s “keep track” undershoots 속속들이 꿰다.
SOL’s “appointed” changes 취임 (assuming office).
넌지시 is how he sent it, not a property of the Sound Transmission.
SOL adds “turns into” and “full-blown” to 나찰이 따로 없으니.
SOL replaces 포스 with unsupported “menace.”
“Bowed deeply” is the natural English for 넙죽 허리를 숙였다; SOL’s waist-bend is stiffer.
Keeps the terse 그 이상이야 fragment; BASE over-completes with “you’re.”
SOL drops 말을 받았다.
SOL’s “he” over-specifies subjectless 놀랍지 않습니까.
“Old-timers” shifts register; 이 늙은이들 is “us old people” in classical-quoting speech.
SOL adds an unsupported “And.”
SOL invents “cultivation” for unspecified 부족한.
SOL’s “flashed” intensifies 스치다.
BASE’s “rolling only my eyes” reads as sarcastic eye-rolling; SOL correctly renders 눈동자만 굴리다.
SOL drops 워낙 (the huge height gap).
SOL adds unsupported “Keep staring and.”
머쓱 is sheepish/awkward, not “embarrassed.”
“You both” already matches 두 사람 모두; SOL is merely different.
“I promise you” and “I promise” are indistinguishable for 약속드리지요.
BASE changes 목소리 to an expression and muddles 되묻다 then 돌아서며.
뭘 어쩌라고 is the speaker’s “what am I supposed to do,” not their expectations.
Restores 가뿐 as a light body and 전후 사정 as the full account.
BASE misattributes 흔쾌한 to the Sect Leaders instead of Taekyung’s answer.
안 보여 is absence from view, not inability.
More direct English for 눈에 띄기 싫다.
놈 supports “he,” and “part of this group” matches 낄.
“I’ll be seeing him” and “I’ll see him” are indistinguishable for 곧 보게 되겠지.
SOL drops 하지만, weakens 마주친, and adds “waiting there.”
터져 나왔다 is a burst; 보자 is “at the sight of.”
SOL reverses 길이 엇갈리다 into paths crossing and weakens 용케도.
SOL invents “lowered my voice”; 숨죽여 속삭였다 is a hushed whisper.
More idiomatic “too embarrassed to say anything.”
저 나이대 is that age group in general, not “his age.”
“Swelling with pride” is more natural than “with a swell of pride.”
그…… is a hesitation filler, not the English article “The.”
SOL drops 저걸 (“that”).
“Came from behind me” already matches 들려오는; SOL is merely different.
English needs the possessive; it does not change whose dreams.
상상 is a thought/imagining, not a “possibility.”
이렇게 된 is the general situation; SOL’s “he” is unsupported.
More natural English for high-speed 신법 without changing the fact.
SOL weakens 요구하는 to “waiting.”
SOL flattens 바에 의하면 그렇다네 into “that is what we learned after.”
“Gruffly” is natural English for 퉁명스러운 목소리로.
More idiomatic without changing the inept-at-formations joke.
SOL drops 설치되어 and intensifies 대단한 to “extraordinary.”
SOL’s 차라리 (“better off”) is right, but it drops 같은; BASE is stiffer.
decisions.replacement: *We’d be better off calling in someone like the Zhuge Clan.*

decisions.reason: More natural “take [them] time to arrive” word order.
“High expectations” is the English collocation for 상당한 기대.
더 is “further/else,” not a comparative “stranger.”
“That’s everything I told you” is the natural English for 말씀드린 게 전붑니다; SOL is just rearranged.
SOL’s “outright” changes 그냥, and “by virtue of existing” is more Latinate than 존재 자체.
마찬가지다 is “no different,” not a new attribution of “strange.”
SOL merges the delayed 이겼다는 게 punchline into one sentence.
“Rough account” and “general account” are indistinguishable for 대략적인.
보고 is “see/look at,” not “examine.”
오줌 쌀 뻔했다 is immediate; SOL’s past perfect needlessly distances it.
SOL drops 계곡 and the [^2] marker, and invents “close to death” for 이 정도.
이었다니 is a present realization that he is the Slaughter Saint, not a past-perfect “had been.”
Comma needed between the independent clauses; SOL is merely different punctuation.
